newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Q2 96/97 BOP has $709.1 mln surplus.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Q2 96/97 BOP has $709.1 mln surplus.

text.p: Egypt's balance of payments had a surplus of $709.1 million in the second quarter of the 1996/7 financial year compared to a deficit of $105.2 million in the first quarter of the year, Central Bank figures showed.

The figures showed the 1996/7 figure compared to a deficit of $131.4 million in the second quarter of the previous year. The payments balance was $201.2 million in surplus at the end of the 1995/6 financial year.
The current account was $173.3 million in surplus for the second quarter of 1996/7 compared to $19.1 million in Q1 and a deficit of $376.4 million in Q2 1995/6.
